executive_summary.market_context: North Bengaluru's Yelahanka belt is dense with private health-science and management colleges: Nitte, Aditya, SB, KNN and Ocean all sit within a few kilometres, and Acharya and Krupanidhi dominate city-wide 'best college in Bangalore' searches. Students compare colleges on aggregators (Careers360, Collegedunia, Shiksha) before they ever reach a college website, so the official site has to win the course-level and fees-level searches the aggregators currently own.
executive_summary.verdict: The site looks modern, but Google can't index it: every page except the homepage returns HTTP 404 when loaded directly, so 3 hard blockers must be fixed before any ranking work pays off.
key_points: 3 hard blockers: all inner pages return 404 on the live server, the published email domain (karnatakacollege.edu) does not exist, and the Privacy Policy and Terms links go nowhere even though the site takes enquiries and payments.
The 404 fix is already written: a Hostinger .htaccess rewrite now ships in the build. It goes live with the next upload of dist/.
Every page sends two title and two meta-description tags, and the first description is always the homepage's, so Google sees 'KCM ... best college in Bangalore' on every URL.
Institution pages are thin (about 100 words each), with no fees, intake, eligibility or faculty, which are exactly the facts that aggregators rank for.
What's working: a clean URL structure for all 11 institutions, a sensible header and footer, EducationalOrganization schema on the homepage, and robots.txt that allows all crawlers.

business_overview.summary: Karnataka College Group of Institutions (KCGI), run by the Karnataka Educational Trust since 1997, operates 11 institutions on one campus at Hegde Nagar, Yelahanka / Thirumenahalli, Bengaluru 560064: pharmacy, nursing, management, management & science, education (B.Ed), law, allied health, paramedical, physiotherapy, a PU college and a CBSE school.
services: Pharmacy (D.Pharm, B.Pharm, M.Pharm, Pharm D, PhD)
areas_served: Students from Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and abroad (per site copy)
business_overview.site_status: Live React single-page app (Vite) on Hostinger. Only '/' returns 200; the other 16 sitemap URLs return 404 when requested directly. Content is rendered by JavaScript only: the raw HTML has no H1 and no body text.

issues.detail: The SPA fallback lives in vercel.json, which Hostinger ignores. /about, /admissions, /contact and all 11 /institution/* pages 404 on direct load or crawl.

issues.issue: Published email domain does not exist
issues.detail: info@, admissions@ and 11 institution addresses use karnatakacollege.edu, which has no DNS. Mail to these addresses bounces. The real mail domain (kcgiedu.org) has Hostinger MX records.

issues.issue: Privacy Policy and Terms link to '#'
issues.detail: The site collects enquiries (NoPaperForms, Supabase) and loads Razorpay checkout but has no legal pages. The footer 'Sitemap' link is also '#'.

issues.issue: Duplicate title and meta description on every page
issues.detail: index.html hard-codes a title and description, and Helmet adds a second set. The first description, which Google usually reads, is the homepage's on every URL.
https://www.kcgiedu.org/ returns 200 rather than 301 to the bare domain, which creates a duplicate copy of the site.

issues.issue: Canonical tag copies the full URL
issues.detail: The canonical is set from window.location.href, so ?utm= and other query URLs canonicalise to themselves. The homepage also emits two canonical tags.
The hero is styled text. Seven H2s, zero H1s.
About 100 words each: two-sentence overview, course names, five bullets. No fees, seats, eligibility, duration, faculty or results.
Meta copy says 'KCM', the title says 'KCGI', the footer says 'over three decades' and the hero says 'since 1997' (29 years). Entity signals are split.

issues.issue: Broken assets referenced in head and schema
issues.detail: manifest.json and favicon.ico return 404. The schema logo URL (/assets/images/logo.png) returns 404. og:image is a relative SVG that social platforms won't render.
080808 33000 is plain text everywhere, with no tel: link, on a site most students visit on mobile.

competitors.name: Acharya Institutes

competitors.strengths: Server-rendered HTML with H1s, a dedicated fees page, a news section and per-college pages (e.g. Acharya & BM Reddy College of Pharmacy).
competitors.weaknesses: No JSON-LD schema on the homepage. Sitemap.xml redirects rather than resolving.

competitors.name: Nitte (Yelahanka campus: NCOPS and others)

competitors.strengths: JSON-LD schema, fee-structure page, active news, and a supporting blog network targeting 'best pharmacy college in Yelahanka'.
competitors.weaknesses: The Yelahanka pharmacy keyword push relies on a Blogspot satellite rather than the main domain.

competitors.name: Krupanidhi Group of Institutions
competitors.scale: Pharmacy, physiotherapy, nursing, business school; pharmacy college NAAC A+

competitors.weaknesses: Homepage is also a JS shell (about 5 KB HTML, no H1, no schema), the same weakness as KCGI.

competitors.name: Aditya Group of Institutions

competitors.strengths: Strong presence on aggregators (Collegedunia, Shiksha, Careers360), one listing per college.
competitors.weaknesses: Official website could not be confirmed during this audit. Aggregator data on founding year and affiliations conflicts.

competitors.name: Sambhram Group of Institutions

competitors.differentiator: Nursing (GNM, B.Sc, M.Sc) competes for the same North Bengaluru students.

competitors.weaknesses: No schema. Thin, inconsistent course listings across aggregators.

competitors.name: Yelahanka nursing colleges (SB, KNN, Ocean)
competitors.differentiator: Win 'nursing college Yelahanka' through aggregator listings, not their own websites.
competitors.strengths: Listed with fees and admission status for 2026-27 on Careers360 and Collegedunia.
competitors.weaknesses: Little or no owned-site SEO, so a strong KCGI nursing page can outrank them.

ai_visibility.summary: AI search bots can reach the homepage, but because inner pages 404 and all content is JS-rendered, AI answers have nothing to cite beyond the homepage shell. Answers about North Bengaluru colleges will draw on Careers360, Collegedunia and Shiksha listings, where KCGI's institution data (fees, ratings) is thin and inconsistent. ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews could not be queried from this environment, so the citation table lists queries to check rather than observed results. Spoofed Googlebot and Bingbot user agents got 403 from Hostinger's CDN; this is normal bot verification, but confirm real Googlebot access with URL Inspection in Search Console.

blockers.title: Deploy the .htaccess fix so inner pages stop returning 404
blockers.detail: Hostinger ignores vercel.json, so every route except '/' 404s on direct load or crawl. Google cannot index /admissions or any institution page.
blockers.fix: Done in code: public/.htaccess (SPA rewrite plus HTTPS/www redirect) is copied into dist/ by the build. Upload the full dist/ (including the hidden .htaccess) to public_html, then confirm /about returns 200 and request indexing in Search Console.

blockers.title: Replace the non-existent karnatakacollege.edu email addresses
blockers.detail: 12 distinct addresses in the footer, Contact, Enquiry and every institution page use a domain with no DNS. Every enquiry email bounces.
blockers.fix: Switch to mailboxes on kcgiedu.org (already has Hostinger MX) in constants.ts, Footer.tsx, ContactUs.tsx and Enquiry.tsx, and make them mailto: links.

blockers.title: Publish Privacy Policy and Terms pages
blockers.detail: The site collects personal data through enquiry forms and Razorpay payments, but the footer legal links are '#'. This is a trust and compliance gap (DPDP Act 2023) and a payment-gateway requirement.
blockers.fix: Add /privacy-policy and /terms routes with real policy text, link them in the footer, and add them to the sitemap. Point the 'Sitemap' footer link to /sitemap.xml or remove it.

quick_wins.title: Remove the static title and description from index.html
quick_wins.detail: Let Helmet own them, so each page has one title and its own description. Also drop the meta keywords tag.

quick_wins.title: Fix canonicals: one tag, origin + pathname only
quick_wins.detail: Build the canonical in SEO.tsx from 'https://kcgiedu.org' + pathname, and remove the duplicate on Home.

quick_wins.title: Expand the sitemap to every real route
quick_wins.detail: Add the about/*, academics/*, admissions/*, facilities, placements and news URLs (about 45) with lastmod, then resubmit in Search Console.

quick_wins.title: Add a homepage H1 and settle on one brand name
quick_wins.detail: e.g. 'Karnataka College Group of Institutions, Yelahanka, Bengaluru'. Use KCGI everywhere (not KCM), and align 'since 1997' and 'three decades'.

quick_wins.title: Fix schema logo, og:image, manifest and favicon
quick_wins.detail: Point the schema at logo.svg or upload logo.png. Use an absolute 1200x630 JPG for og:image. Move manifest.json into public/ and add a favicon.

quick_wins.title: Make the phone number tappable everywhere
quick_wins.detail: tel:+918080833000 in the header, footer, contact and institution cards.

quick_wins.title: Shrink the 652 KB logo and compress card images
quick_wins.detail: The logo SVG probably embeds a raster; export a clean SVG or WebP. Convert the 11 institution images to WebP at about 600px wide.

quick_wins.title: Add Course + CollegeOrUniversity schema per institution
quick_wins.detail: Generate it from constants.ts in InstitutionDetail: name, address, the parent organisation, and each course with its duration.

quick_wins.title: Replace the catch-all redirect with a real 404 page
quick_wins.detail: Render a noindex 'Page not found' page with links, instead of Navigate to '/', to avoid soft 404s.

quick_wins.title: Build Tailwind at compile time instead of using the CDN
quick_wins.detail: cdn.tailwindcss.com compiles CSS in the browser on every visit and is not meant for production.

opportunities.title: Win the Yelahanka course searches with real facts
opportunities.gap: For 'pharmacy college Yelahanka' and 'nursing college Yelahanka', results are aggregator listings and a Nitte Blogspot. No local college's own site answers fees, seats, eligibility and RGUHS/PCI/INC status on one page.
opportunities.why: Students and parents shortlist by course plus area plus fees. KCGI already has 11 institution URLs with clean slugs; they only lack substance.
opportunities.action: Rebuild the pharmacy, nursing and physiotherapy pages first: fees, intake, eligibility, duration, approvals with letter numbers, faculty, labs with real photos, an admission timeline, and Course schema. Then add one page per flagship course.

opportunities.title: Own the out-of-state nursing and allied-health student
opportunities.gap: Site copy and meta keywords target Kerala, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana students, but no page speaks to them, and competitors only cover it through aggregators.
opportunities.why: Bengaluru nursing and allied-health colleges draw heavily from Kerala. These families research hostels, safety, travel and nursing-council registration before applying, and nobody answers those questions in one place.
opportunities.action: Publish an 'Out-of-state students' hub covering hostel, fees, KNC/INC registration transfer, travel from Kerala, and testimonials from such students, linked from each health-science institution page.

opportunities.title: Fix the aggregator footprint AI answers draw on
opportunities.gap: KCGI's ratings are fragmented: Shiksha 3.6, CollegeDekho 4.7, Careers360 3.6 from one review. A 'KCM' listing on TimesOfCollege is split from the group. Aditya, in the same pincode, has a fuller aggregator presence.
opportunities.why: Students and AI answers both lean on these listings. A consistent name, address, fees and approvals across them is the cheapest way to show up in AI answers.
opportunities.action: Claim the Careers360, Collegedunia, Shiksha and CollegeDekho profiles for each institution, standardise the name 'Karnataka College Group of Institutions (KCGI)' and the NAP, link back to the matching kcgiedu.org page, and run a post-admission review drive with current students.

closing.headline: The first fix is already written
closing.body: The 404 fix ships with the next upload of dist/. The two other blockers (email addresses and legal pages) are a day's work. The quick wins after that are about two working days in total. Then the institution page rebuild, starting with pharmacy, nursing and physiotherapy, is where rankings will come from.
closing.cta: Next step: deploy dist/ to Hostinger, verify in Search Console, then start on the quick-win list.
